## ZXTouch Rootless

System-wide touch simulation for **iOS 15-17**. Supports Dopamine, Dopamine 3, and NathanLR (rootless), plus Roothide/Serotonin.

### Features
- Touch simulation (up to 19 fingers)
- Python script automation
- Recording timeline editor
- Persistent remote dashboard
- Image matching (no OpenCV)
- OCR via Vision framework
- Color picker & searcher
- Text input & keyboard control
- iOS Shortcuts integration
- Dark mode

### Requirements
- iOS 15.0 - 17.7
- Dopamine, Dopamine 3, NathanLR, or Roothide jailbreak
- Python 3 from Procursus is required for `.py` scripts

## v0.08.30
